visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair, wearing a gray athletic shirt with an orange logo and black sleeves, sits on a light brown wooden bench in a baseball dugout. He looks at the camera while speaking. Behind him are posters and a beige wall. (2) The scene shifts to an outdoor night view of a restaurant entrance. A bright red vertical banner with gold characters hangs next to a window. Inside, white bowls are stacked neatly on shelves under warm, glowing lights. The environment is calm. (3) Close-up of a hand holding a detailed paper menu with red and black text columns. The hand uses a blue pen to point at specific rows under a category. The lighting is bright and overhead, highlighting the text on the white paper. (4) A white bowl filled with glistening cubes of white tofu and purple taro pieces is presented. Shaved ice forms the base, and a golden-brown syrup is drizzled over the top. The bowl sits on a wooden table under warm indoor lighting. (5) A young man with dark, wavy hair and a blue collared shirt sits at a table and eats the tofu dessert. He uses a metal spoon to take a large portion. His facial expressions show enjoyment as he tastes the soft, milky food.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 台南棒球場附近的球員私藏美食. (2) [Subtitle]: 今天讓統一獅捕手陳重羽來推薦. (3) [Subtitle]: 走路可以到的哦. (4) [Subtitle]: 五妃街那個杏仁豆腐冰. (5) [Subtitle]: 算是從小吃到大嗎. (6) [Subtitle]: 沒有我又不是台南人. (7) [Subtitle]: 很喜歡吃甜點. (8) [Subtitle]: 我會吃那個鮮奶. (9) [Subtitle]: 我不喜歡杏仁的味道. (10) [Subtitle]: 杏仁豆腐冰對就這樣. (11) [Subtitle]: 我不喜歡其他那些什麼. (12) [Subtitle]: 有的沒的配料. (13) [Subtitle]: 有有有這個有. (14) [Subtitle]: 這間杏仁豆腐冰我個人是從小吃到大. (15) [Subtitle]: 但我每次都點杏仁的. (16) [Subtitle]: 這次照重羽的吃法點了鮮奶豆腐冰+煉乳(我自己又偷偷加了芋頭). (17) [Subtitle]: 豆腐吃起來很像奶酪軟嫩又有鮮奶香. (18) [Subtitle]: 這碗我一個人可以輕鬆解決. (19) [Subtitle]: 是夏天來台南看球想吃冰的第一首選推薦給大家.
